subject: Weekly Exec Spotlight: accelerator sprint status & QBR readiness
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:14:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly Exec Spotlight: accelerator sprint status & QBR readiness

Hi all —

Short update ahead of next week's QBR planning slot. This is the accelerator sprint readout (week 3 of 6). I attached the sprint metrics and the QBR readiness checklist; key highlights below.

Wins:
- Median inference latency for the <redwood/opt-llama> pilot is down 18% after the kernel tuning patch; p99 improved from 420ms to 345ms on our staging fleet.
- Initial customer-facing experiments with KV prefix caching for Acme AI show a 23% token cost reduction on repeat flows.
- Onboarding checklist for the Dedicated beta is 80% complete; legal sign-off for the standard SOW template is in hand.

Risks / open items:
- Productionization of the new batching policy still shows a spiky tail at 99.9th percentile under mixed workloads; root cause looks like small-sample scheduling edge cases. Owner: Karthik.
- Acme AI procurement needs final pricing confirmation by Friday to hit their target launch (deal ACME-COMMIT-42). Procurement contact asked for a short mutual action plan + final SLA appendix.
- QBR slide deck needs concrete cost-per-1k-token comparisons across model variants; numbers in the attached spreadsheet are draft.

Asks (short):
1) Karthik — can you confirm the timeline (+1 day/-1 day) for the batching schedule fix and whether we should plan a canary on Dedicated on Mon 6/7?
2) Laura — can you and Marissa take point on the Acme procurement appendix and loop legal if needed? They want a DocuSign link by EOD Fri.
3) Jonas — will you run a 30-minute dry-run of the QBR technical section on Tue 6/8 (block requested in calendar).

Attachments: accelerator-sprint-metrics.xlsx (metrics + draft cost calc), qbr-ready-checklist.pdf (slides & asks). Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/g/accelerator-sprint-2027

Quick note: I'll push updated numbers on Thu evening and send a follow-up summary.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly Exec Spotlight: accelerator sprint status & QBR readiness

Thanks Neha — useful snapshot. A couple quick points: 

- I reviewed the attached metrics and added a small tab with 'customer-facing talking points' (rows highlighted). Please check accuracy; I edited the cost assumptions so double-check with Marcus or finance if those still look low.
- For Acme: we can take the SLA appendix but need product to confirm the data-retention window (they asked for 90 days; our standard is 30 unless on Dedicated). Can someone confirm if Dedicated will be able to meet 90 days for logs and KV prefixes?

On asks:
- Marissa and I will lead the procurement appendix. Marissa, I'll loop legal now and draft the DocuSign envelope; Neha, please confirm the final committed discount threshold so we can populate the SOW.
- Jonas — if you can do Tue 6/8 10:30–11:00 PT for the dry-run that works for me.

I can take the dry-run. Tentative confirmation for Tue 6/8 10:30–11:00 PT; I'll send the calendar invite and a short runbook for the demo sequence (service-level graphs, canary plan, fallback variants).

Karthik — on the batching spike, can you put a short note in the runbook about expected behavior post-fix and the SLO rollback plan? If the canary looks flaky we'll default to the current policy and call out a follow-up remediation sprint.

Cc: 
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly Exec Spotlight: accelerator sprint status & QBR readiness — updated numbers + DocuSign prep

Laura / Marissa — attaching the updated sprint metrics with the corrected cost rows and the populated QBR checklist. I also drafted the mutual action plan for Acme (see tab 'Acme MAP') and set the committed discount threshold to 18% (per our margin model discussed in finance sync).

Acme procurement — looping you in here to share the MAP; the DocuSign envelope will come from Legal once Marissa confirms the SOW text. We expect a 48-hour turnaround for signature to keep the launch timeline.

Karthik — the batching fix is scheduled to be deployed to canary on Mon 6/7 at 08:00 PT; please add your rollback instructions to the runbook Jonas will circulate.

Jonas — confirmed for Tue 6/8 10:30–11:00 PT dry-run. I'll be presenting the customer economics section; please coordinate slides with me by EOD Mon.

Attachments: accelerator-sprint-metrics.xlsx (v2), qbr-ready-checklist.pdf (v2). HubSpot: https://hubspot.app/records/ACME-42

Thanks everyone — pushing this to the QBR pack now.

—
Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
